entities.name: Hugo Schäffer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hugo Schäffer was a German politician. He was initially a non-partisan politician, as was then common, but joined the Nazi Party in 1933. He served as Reich Minister for Labour in Franz von Papen's cabinet for 163 days in 1932 when he was ousted after Papen could not secure the Reichstag following the November 1932 German federal election.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hugo Schäffer was a German politician. He was initially a non-partisan politician, as was then common, but joined the Nazi Party in 1933. He served as Reich Minister for Labour in Franz von Papen's cabinet for 163 days in 1932 when he was ousted after Papen could not secure the Reichstag following the November 1932 German federal election.
